job_description_text:
Job Title: Security Guard

We are hiring a Security Guard to maintain safety and security within the premises. The candidate will monitor visitors, patrol the area, and ensure company property is protected from unauthorized access or suspicious activities.

Responsibilities:
Monitor entry and exit points.
Patrol the premises regularly.
Report suspicious activities or incidents.
Maintain visitor records.
Respond to emergencies when required.
Skills Required:
Basic communication skills.
Alertness and responsibility.
Ability to follow instructions.
Qualification:
Minimum high school education.
Prior experience is preferred but not mandatory.
